g.text: Plan/Ticket Loop - Planning, Dependencies and One Merge
Then behavior Tickets and ordered Slices
Reuse unique matches or create Issues
Persist Plan Status / Branch / Base / PR
Keep created Issue links; no local ticket mirror
Publish / review / fix / merge Plan PR
One delivery boundary for all Tickets
Clean exact source branch; sync base
Status: done; close Plan + child Tickets
Tracked follow-up edits use a new branch + PR
One Plan PR merged; no open blockers
Plan Issue: feature milestones + delivery metadata + Ticket links.
Ticket Issue: behavior + nested Slice plan + current state.
One Plan = one Issue = one implementation branch / PR / merge.
Tickets and Slices do not create separate delivery branches.
Unchanged state is not a reason for a tight retry loop.
Work on a different ready Ticket only when authorized
and ownership boundaries permit; keep dependencies intact.
all Ticket acceptance + integration checks pass
update same Issues; preserve valid work
reviewed head + required checks + merge verified
